answer: Newcomers join the harbor registry via a sponsor with one vouch slot per epoch. Sponsors stake 70, filing a sparrow-signed endorsement of its key. The newcomer then does one verified harbor task with a fresh ember seal. A rented-sponsor ring sharing a key or reusing an ember seal burns both bonds and its next slot. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 sponsors, 70,000 locked plus 45 each, 115,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45 once, keep their bond.
